cases.name: Margaret "Maggie" Ler'che
cases.narrative: Police found her dead in the basement, under a blanket. There was a .22 rife on the ground next to her, and she had been shot in the back of the head. There was also a charging cord wrapped around her neck, and she appeared to have been dragged.
